scope: Targeted refinement of 8 high-leverage complex compositions across Android M3 Expressive and iOS Apple HIG

alternatives_evaluated.description: Large editorial hero carousel with sticky horizontal filter chips and staggered dual-column destination cards.

critique.truth: PASS — Truth badges positioned prominently on all card headers.
critique.platform_idiom: PASS — Standard M3 TopAppBar scrolling behavior with elevation overlay.
critique.accessibility: PASS — High contrast text, touch targets meet 48dp minimum.
critique.information_hierarchy: STRONG — Hero introduces cultural context before district cards.
critique.one_hand_use: GOOD — Filter chips reachable within thumb arc.
critique.travel_during_use: EXCELLENT — Quick district toggle for field transitions.
critique.offline_states: PASS — Offline status chip docks cleanly into TopAppBar subtitle.
critique.visual_restraint: PASS — Zero neon accents; warm basalt and sandstone ochre palette.

alternatives_evaluated.description: Prominent search bar anchored at top with single-column dense list rows.

critique.platform_idiom: ACCEPTABLE — More utilitarian, less editorial atlas feel.

alternatives_evaluated.description: Collapsible image hero with integrated photographer attribution, Odia title block, practical info card grid, and floating navigation action button.

critique.truth: PASS — Mandatory verified photo gate; provenance card displays survey agency.
critique.platform_idiom: PASS — M3 LargeTopAppBar collapsible behavior with ExtendedFloatingActionButton.
critique.accessibility: PASS — Focus order flows logically from identity to practical visiting facts.
critique.information_hierarchy: STRONG — Visiting hours and ticket requirements prioritized above narrative.
critique.one_hand_use: EXCELLENT — Navigation FAB anchored in bottom right quadrant.
critique.travel_during_use: EXCELLENT — Emergency contact and dress code readable in sunlight.
critique.offline_states: PASS — Cached indicator clearly displayed if viewing offline pack.
critique.visual_restraint: PASS — Restrained typography using Inter/Roboto with Noto Sans Odia.

alternatives_evaluated.description: Prominent top card for the current active stop with oversized 'Arrived' button, connected to vertical scrollable timeline of completed and upcoming stops.

critique.truth: PASS — Strict manual check-in; zero fake automatic GPS simulation.
critique.platform_idiom: PASS — M3 tonal card elevations and vertical timeline indicators.
critique.accessibility: PASS — Milestone actions exceed 56dp touch targets.
critique.information_hierarchy: EXCELLENT — Clear distinction between active task and remaining journey.
critique.one_hand_use: EXCELLENT — Primary 'Arrived' button positioned for immediate thumb reach.
critique.travel_during_use: SUPERIOR — High glanceability while walking or riding.
critique.offline_states: PASS — 100% executable offline with zero network dependency.
critique.visual_restraint: PASS — Clean functional typography; no gamified point counters.

alternatives_evaluated.description: Top 35% map view showing surveyed route polyline, bottom 65% scrollable stop sequence with scheduled departure pill and candidate stop disclosures.

critique.truth: PASS — Labeled as 'Scheduled Timetable'; candidate stops shown with dashed outline.
critique.platform_idiom: PASS — M3 BottomSheet / scaffold split layout with MapLibre surface.
critique.accessibility: PASS — Full stop list readable linearly via TalkBack.
critique.information_hierarchy: STRONG — Next scheduled departure pinned at top of list.
critique.one_hand_use: GOOD — Bottom stop list easily flicked and explored.
critique.travel_during_use: SUPERIOR — Traveler can confirm upcoming stop while on board.
critique.offline_states: PASS — Consumes bundled canonical transit graph offline.
critique.visual_restraint: PASS — Sandstone corridor color; no animated fake bus dots.

alternatives_evaluated.description: iOS large navigation title ('Discover') with New York serif font, inset horizontal district capsules, full-width editorial cards with continuous 12pt corners.

critique.truth: PASS — Verified badges integrated into card metadata pills.
critique.platform_idiom: SUPERIOR — Pure Apple HIG publication feel; native navigation transitions.
critique.accessibility: PASS — Dynamic Type reflows cards vertically on large text sizes.
critique.information_hierarchy: EXCELLENT — Curated cultural collections clearly delineated by section headers.
critique.one_hand_use: EXCELLENT — Standard iOS edge swipe back gesture enabled.
critique.travel_during_use: GOOD — Quick browsing in high glare.
critique.offline_states: PASS — Offline status banner sits cleanly under navigation bar.
critique.visual_restraint: PASS — Warm basalt canvas with SF Pro / New York typography.

alternatives_evaluated.description: Hero media carousel header with page dots, followed by Inset Grouped sections for Visiting Hours, Cultural Significance, and Verified Provenance.

critique.truth: PASS — Verified photo requirement strictly respected.
critique.accessibility: PASS — Section headers announced; VoiceOver navigates grouped items cleanly.
critique.information_hierarchy: STRONG — Facts segregated cleanly into native grouped cells.
critique.one_hand_use: GOOD — Pull down to dismiss modal sheet if presented as sheet.
critique.travel_during_use: EXCELLENT — Rapid verification of opening times and ticket costs.
critique.offline_states: PASS — Shows local SQLite cached record seamlessly.
critique.visual_restraint: PASS — System background colors with subtle hairline separators.

alternatives_evaluated.description: Pinned toolbar showing progress gauge, hero card with next destination and 'Mark Arrived' button with CoreHaptics confirmation, swipeable milestone list.

critique.truth: PASS — Explicit user action required to advance milestones.
critique.platform_idiom: SUPERIOR — Native SwiftUI sheet presentation with detents.
critique.information_hierarchy: EXCELLENT — Active milestone visually isolated from upcoming queue.
critique.one_hand_use: SUPERIOR — Action button anchored directly above tab bar.
critique.travel_during_use: EXCELLENT — Haptic confirmation allows eyes-free confirmation.
critique.offline_states: PASS — Fully autonomous local SQLite state.
critique.visual_restraint: PASS — No gamified confetti or fake badges.

alternatives_evaluated.description: Full-screen MapKit view with surveyed route polyline, overlaid with native SwiftUI bottom sheet (.presentationDetents([.fraction(0.35), .large])) containing stop sequence.

critique.truth: PASS — Timetable clearly labeled 'Scheduled Departures'; fares shown as unconfirmed.
critique.platform_idiom: SUPERIOR — Perfect adoption of iOS 17+ MapKit + presentationDetents.
critique.accessibility: PASS — Detent changes announced to VoiceOver; full stop list accessible in large detent.
critique.information_hierarchy: EXCELLENT — Map and timetable coexist without layout conflict.
critique.one_hand_use: EXCELLENT — Single-finger flick between peek and expanded detent.
critique.travel_during_use: SUPERIOR — Ideal for transit navigation while walking or waiting at shelter.
critique.offline_states: PASS — Offline transit graph rendered locally without network.
critique.visual_restraint: PASS — Elegant sandstone polyline with SF Mono schedule timestamps.
